name: Race rules
summary: The race itself: countdown, laps, sectors, positions, finish, car-to-car contacts, snapshots, race settings and entries (crews), and building a race from start data.
notes: Pure data, no nodes, deterministic. Damage: settings.damage_level (off/visual/full); the sim damages cars from contacts and barrier hits and emits incident / retired events (is_retired()). Safety car, pit stops and fuel rules plug in here.
